rules.condition: fearless_bit ; session_new_specials()==0 ; for weaplist: dead/self ; order Weapon && same floor ; rally_radius > 0 ; is_friendly ; dist^2 <= r^2
rules.semantic: A walker is fearless (never flees when hit, a fright binding skips it) if it carries the kit FEARLESS mark, or, with New Specials on, if a live friendly weapon-order rally object (war banner: a weapon family declaring rally_radius > 0) stands on its floor within rally_radius of its centre. With New Specials off a banner-like pack weapon never makes anyone fearless.

arms.observable: false even next to a banner

arms.when: friendly live banner within radius, same floor
arms.observable: true; yell does not start the flee walk

arms.when: banner dead / other floor / foe team / out of radius
the walker is itself the rally weapon (rally == &w)
arms.observable: skipped: a rally weapon is not made fearless by its own radius

arms.when: weapon on weaplist whose family rally_radius <= 0
arms.observable: skipped: false unless another banner qualifies

tests.note: mark; in radius true + no flee; out of radius; foe-team banner both ways; other floor; setting off false next to a banner; dead banner false
in radius, foe side, setting off, out of radius

missing_arms: the walker is itself the rally weapon (rally == &w)
weapon on weaplist whose family rally_radius <= 0
